title: AI Token Futures Trading is Coming and I'm Completely Confused Why
description: TechCrunch just reported that we'll soon be able to trade AI token futures just like gold and oil commodities. This makes zero sense to me on multiple levels. Unlike physical commodities, AI is technology we literally make up and control ourselves. What exactly would these futures be based on? How do you regulate something so artificially created? This seems ripe for market manipulation in ways that traditional commodities aren't. I'm skeptical this will actually happen despite the TechCrunch coverage, but it's worth watching where this bizarre idea leads. The comparison to established commodity markets feels completely off base when you think about the fundamental differences between physical resources and artificial intelligence tokens.
